sources.snippet: Olmo 3 7B Instruct is a 7-billion-parameter instruction-following model from Allen AI, supporting 64K long context. As a representative of open-source high performance, it excels in code generation, logical reasoning, and general dialogue.

sources.title: Olmo-3-7B-Instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Olmo-3-7B-Instruct is a 7-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model developed by allenai and built on the Olmo 3 architecture. The model uses a Transformer-style autoregressive design with 32 layers, 4096 hidden size, 32 query heads, and 32 key-value heads, processing up to 65,536 tokens of context.
